status: Independent source-supported software fixture truth; not medical gold labels.
description: Manual extraction, quotation validation, reviewer disagreement, source-version revisions, and conditional eligibility/linkage restoration. All source content, values, contexts, and instrument judgments are invented software fixtures. No clinical inference, patient data, model output or real-paper gold annotation.
anchor_rule: Unicode code points in the exact pinned canonical block text, half-open [start,end). Values/context support requires human judgment even when an exact quote validates.

setup.initial_state: Every report is full-text included and has a resolved complete study-link set [study_alpha]; only its initial source is attached. Replacement sources attach explicitly within scenarios. The evaluator supplies actual ledger IDs through these aliases. No same-title/clinical identity inference.
setup.identity_limit: Declared reviewer strings exercise separation; these fixture identities are not authenticated accounts.

binding_rules.proposal: Resolve target aliases to project_id, record_id, study_id and the active document_id, then pass the complete input to propose_evidence. Expected locator is added by the API, not caller input.
binding_rules.revision: Resolve target/evidence aliases and pass the complete replacement payload to revise_evidence. kind is inherited from the stable evidence; appraisal=None is explicit for finding revisions. document_ref_override denotes the newest separately attached copy.
binding_rules.scenario: Each scenario starts from an independent fresh setup with no evidence. event_ref/revision_ref/evidence_ref bind returned IDs. Unsupported test operation labels describe evaluator setup actions, not new operational APIs. Reject operations must raise ValueError with no evidence revision/review history change.
binding_rules.linkage: Evaluator creates declared current state using existing complete-set linkage APIs; resolved study_aliases are the complete association, and unresolved can be empty/pending or conflicted.
binding_rules.counts: history_counts count only evidence revisions/reviews in this isolated scenario, including superseded events; source attachments and screening/linkage events do not increment them.
binding_rules.active_events: Compare listed active event references as a set. Effective adjudication alone applies; any later review invalidates it and reinstates latest votes per reviewer. No vote inheritance between revisions.
binding_rules.exports: At each scenario step, verified_evidence must contain its current revision exactly when verified=true. Audit exports retain all superseded revisions/reviews. Source/block/revision hash provenance must agree; no automatic entailment assertion.
